data.title: Farm Hub (FamHub) Privacy Policy
data.body:
*Last updated: November 9, 2026*

This policy applies to the **Farm Hub** application (international store name: *FamHub - Family Check-ins*, hereafter "the App"), developed by **Cross Technology and Education (Cross Tech Edu)**.

**Summary:** The App does not collect personal data, does not require an account, does not display tracking ads, and does not sell your data.

## 1. Data the App does not collect

Cross Tech Edu does not collect, store on servers, or share any personal data through the App, including: name, email, phone number, contacts, photos, messages.

## 2. Location data

Live location is only shared when the child taps the on-button on their own screen. Coordinates are transmitted only between paired devices in the family and are automatically deleted from our server after **60 minutes**. Location is never used for advertising.

## 3. Pairing code

The child pairs their device with the parent's phone using a 6-character code. No email or password required.

## 4. Your rights

You can permanently delete your account in the App's Settings. Upon deletion, all linked data is removed from Cross Tech Edu's servers.

## 5. Contact

Email: crosstechedu@gmail.com
Phone: +84 33 830 5895
Office: Hanoi, Vietnam
